title: ASC 940 – Financial Services–Brokers and Dealers
summary: Governs trade date accounting, customer protection through asset segregation, and fail-to-deliver positions for brokers and dealers.
description: ASC 940 addresses trade date versus settlement date accounting, the universal fair value through earnings requirement for trading securities, receivables and payables to customers and broker-dealers, and fails to deliver and receive. It also establishes customer protection requirements for asset segregation.

bannerNotice.title: No Direct IFRS Equivalent
bannerNotice.body: No dedicated IFRS broker-dealer standard exists. While general IFRS standards on financial instruments apply, ASC 940's specific broker-dealer guidance lacks a direct counterpart.
